# Glossary

The words this fixture keeps, for a project whose screens and services each
have a vocabulary of their own.

## Screens

### Includes

- `app/ui/*.rb`

### Component

What a screen is built from.

#### Rejected

- `Widget` — Component is what the screens call it.

## Services

### Includes

- `app/backend/*.rb`

### Service

What a screen calls.

#### Rejected

- `Daemon` — Service is what the backend calls it.
